items.item:
5. A sign-in during a lockout is refused and does not extend it.
   Shows A13-2. [witness: verification:registry_a13_lockout_sign_in_not_extending]
statements:
t < s.last_request + 30min and
                                not signed_out(s) and no restart since s.began
refused_sign_ins(last 15min) >= 5 => sign_in refused   -- A13-2

verdicts.item:
5. A sign-in during a lockout is refused and does not extend it.
   Shows A13-2. [witness: verification:registry_a13_lockout_sign_in_not_extending]
statements:
t < s.last_request + 30min and
                                not signed_out(s) and no restart since s.began
refused_sign_ins(last 15min) >= 5 => sign_in refused   -- A13-2
verdicts.why: Five refused sign-ins establish the lockout; subsequent right- and wrong-credential sign-ins are detected as refused. Acceptance exactly 15 minutes after the original fifth refusal, despite intervening attempts, asserts that those attempts neither count toward nor extend the lockout.
